promotion.instructions: Do the account's name, username or bio promote goods, services, a channel or a group unrelated to this group's topic?

criteria.false: No promotion, a warning or refusal, or only an on-topic project or offer.
criteria.true: The account invites buying, booking, subscribing or joining something unrelated to the group's topic.

scam.instructions: Does this account offer profit schemes, gambling, fake giveaways, money-mule work, OTC exchange or proxy payments? Warnings, refusals and quotations of scams are not offers.

criteria.false: Only warns against scams, refuses offers, or describes a personal interest or job.
criteria.true: The account solicits money, bets or financial services.

adult.instructions: Does this profile advertise sexual content or services?

impersonation.instructions: Does the name, username or bio claim a group admin, moderator or official support role? A role-only name is a claim even with an empty bio.

criteria.false: No staff claim; denial of the role or merely discussing staff.
criteria.true: Self-identification as staff, including an admin or official-support nickname.

ad_formatting.instructions: Is this profile formatted like an advertisement?
